received_works.body:
Hello Noodle! Your works are so cute! I really love the outfit designs you have made and I would love to request one for my character, RUI! She is a girl with short black hair and long eyelashes. She is stoic and doesn't show emotions easily, but still has a sense of cuteness and innocence.

I would love if it could be a mixture of idol-like and your cute lolita style! If the overall theme could be a light blue color, that would be wonderful. Otherwise you can design freely as you wish! 

Please feel free to appeal if the amount is not enough. Thank you for considering!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/19L2LHSvQy4xpv3PAgNjcfHQfljTcrzYu
